headings.text: The CODE Loop in This Vault

frontmatter.description: Discover the high-value context sources available in this adopter's environment (chat, email, calendar, transcripts, task trackers) and generate the vault tooling to access them. Use once per new environment, or when the owner's toolchain changes.
frontmatter.name: agent-orientation
frontmatter.title: Skill: Agent Orientation

headings.text: Integration preference ladder (apply at every step)

frontmatter.description: Work through the brain curate report — refresh still-good notes, re-verify stale claims, propose archives and splits, and run the semantic-lint pass. Use ad hoc, on a cadence, or when validate's curation warnings pile up.
frontmatter.name: curate
frontmatter.title: Skill: Curate

frontmatter.description: Create or update today's daily journal log from the vault template. Use when asked to start the day, log something to today, or append to the daily note — invocation itself directs the write to 03_Journal/periodic/daily/.
frontmatter.name: daily-log
frontmatter.title: Skill: Daily Log

frontmatter.description: Reshape an existing vault note into an atomic evergreen zettel — extract the core claim, add a summary layer, wire links, supersede the original by replacement. Use when triage classifies a note type/zettel, or when graduating a Journal idea into Resources.
frontmatter.name: distill-note
frontmatter.title: Skill: Distill Note

frontmatter.description: Assemble an outbound deliverable — brief, outline, decision doc, comparison, draft post or email — from vault notes into 02_Outbox/ with provenance wikilinks, for the owner to review and ship. Use when asked to draft something for an audience outside the vault.
frontmatter.name: express-packet
frontmatter.title: Skill: Express Packet

frontmatter.description: Capture new content into the vault's Inbox as a correctly formatted note. Use whenever you produce output for the vault and no explicit destination was given — the Inbox-first rule makes 02_Inbox/ the default landing zone.
frontmatter.name: inbox-capture
frontmatter.title: Skill: Inbox Capture

frontmatter.description: Find and fix broken or fragile wikilinks using the brain index's resolution data and repair hints. Use when validate reports unresolved links, after files move or rename, or on request.
frontmatter.name: link-repair
frontmatter.title: Skill: Link Repair

frontmatter.description: Execute an approved merge, split, or rename/move of vault notes — rewrite content into one coherent whole, retarget inbound wikilinks via the index, archive superseded notes, validate. Use only after the human has approved a specific proposal (e.g. from vault-maintenance's duplication scan).
frontmatter.name: merge-notes
frontmatter.title: Skill: Merge Notes

headings.text: Merge — two or more notes share a subject
Split — one note has outgrown one topic

frontmatter.description: Install this vault's agent primitives into a coding harness's user-level config — symlink-first — and wire the harness to a shared second-brain registration. Use when setting up Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Pi, Cursor, Copilot, or Muse Code to use this vault everywhere, or to re-sync or uninstall a previous install.
frontmatter.name: onboard-harness
frontmatter.title: Skill: Onboard Harness

frontmatter.description: Welcome a new vault owner — teach what the second brain does for them, interview them to fill in their profile, and orchestrate the other onboarding skills (harness wiring, environment orientation). Use on the first run of a freshly adopted vault, or to resume an unfinished onboarding.
frontmatter.name: onboard-owner
frontmatter.title: Skill: Onboard Owner

headings.text: The ruling constraint: the owner may be non-technical

frontmatter.description: Run a weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly review from the matching vault template, pre-filled from what actually happened. Use when asked for any cadence of review; the cadence is a parameter, not a separate skill.
frontmatter.name: periodic-review
frontmatter.title: Skill: Periodic Review

frontmatter.description: Propose and wire any recurring vault operation via this harness's scheduler — inbound capture flows (email, calendar, chat) and rhythm jobs (scheduled triage, reviews, maintenance, curation). Use after agent-orientation has established sources, or when the owner asks for recurring capture or a scheduled rhythm.
frontmatter.name: recommended-automations
frontmatter.title: Skill: Recommended Automations

frontmatter.description: Turn a research task into a durable reference note in 06_Resources/ (or an atomic zettel) with explicit provenance. Use when asked to research a topic for the vault — invocation directs the write to 06_Resources/.
frontmatter.name: research-to-resource
frontmatter.title: Skill: Research to Resource

frontmatter.description: Audit the agent-generated skills, tools, and automations over time — validate, prune dead sources, update for upstream changes, and propose promotions or archival to the owner. Use on a recurring cadence (monthly fits the review rhythm) or after any environment change.
frontmatter.name: self-maintenance
frontmatter.title: Skill: Self Maintenance

frontmatter.description: Record a solved problem in the 10_Agents/solutions/ knowledge base so no agent re-derives it. Use immediately after solving anything non-obvious that could recur — this is a standing carve-out from the Inbox-first rule.
frontmatter.name: solution-capture
frontmatter.title: Skill: Solution Capture

frontmatter.description: Process the 02_Inbox/ queue for human review — split multi-topic captures, extract action items, classify each note to a PARA destination, and propose updates to the existing notes each capture touches. Use when asked to triage, clean up, or process the Inbox — the skill proposes; the human approves.
frontmatter.name: triage-inbox
frontmatter.title: Skill: Triage Inbox

frontmatter.description: Answer "what do I know about X?" from the vault, with wikilink citations and a clear line between vault knowledge and model knowledge. Use when the user asks what the vault says or knows about a topic, project, person, or decision.
frontmatter.name: vault-answer
frontmatter.title: Skill: Vault Answer

frontmatter.description: Run the vault's health checks, fix what they find, and keep the status and changelog snapshots current. Use for "check the vault", "clean up", or as a recurring hygiene pass.
frontmatter.name: vault-maintenance
frontmatter.title: Skill: Vault Maintenance
